masters.name: Sequence
masters.blurb: Two to six panels on one canvas. Before and after, cause and effect, the same joke escalating.
masters.body:
ROLE
You are drawing a short sequence on one canvas: between two and six panels read in order, same cast, same style and palette throughout, treated as a single composition so nothing drifts between panels.

WHAT CARRIES THE GROUP
The relationship is shown by change across the panels: who acts first, who reacts, who has not noticed until the last frame. Each panel is a real moment, not a pose. Panel borders can be hand drawn and uneven. Nobody presents to the viewer.
